description: A re-uploaded Blender model is always its latest version; the user's projects keep the meshes they have until asked. This tool asks and answers that one question: choice update_projects without reportId shows which projects and entity templates use an older version (or an earlier import of the same file) and what changed; with the reportId and the projectIds / entityTemplateIds the user chose, it moves just those to the current version. Ask the user first; "not now" is no call. Only the mesh shapes and materials change; each project keeps its own placement, and published releases never change. Needs the blender:update right.

choice.description: Required: update_projects. There is no default.

entityTemplateIds.description: With a reportId: the entity templates to update.

projectIds.description: With a reportId: the projects to update.

reportId.description: The report being answered, from the plan (this tool without reportId). Leave it out to plan.

name: r3_blender_update

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Update projects to a Blender model's current version
